title: spec-pipeline configuration (.claude/spec-pipeline.json)
description: Project configuration for the spec-pipeline command and workflow. The orchestrator command reads this file at Step 0 and passes it verbatim as args.config on every Workflow call; the workflow script applies the defaults below and validates the subset it relies on. See docs/configuration.md.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editor support. Ignored by the pipeline.

version.description: Contract version. The workflow script errors on any other value.

name.description: Project name, used in prompts and the PR body.

description.description: One sentence inlined into the triage prompt so the drafter knows the stakes framing.

specs_dir.description: Repo-relative directory holding the three templates and the per-slug artifacts. No trailing slash.

agents_dir.description: Where agent definitions live; cited in role sentences and the spec template's routing rule.

rules_dir.description: Path-scoped rules directory. Prompts say 'if that directory exists', so it may be absent.

steering.description: The steering file and the headings prompts cite by name. Headings include their leading #'s.

branch_prefixes.description: Triage's branch_prefix enum; branches are <prefix>/<slug>. First = new capability, second = correcting behaviour; with one, every workstream uses it.

remove_artifacts_after_pr.description: true: ship commits the artifacts, links the spec by SHA permalink, then removes them from the branch tip (requires merge commits). false: the artifacts stay on the branch and merge with the PR (use with squash-merge repos).

triage_agent.description: agentType that drafts, revises, and critiques triage. null means lanes[0].architect.

lanes.description: The routing domains. Lane names must be unique (checked by the workflow and scripts/verify-adoption.sh).

name.description: Lane token (kebab-case); appears on the triage **Lane**: line and in the triage lane enum.

description.description: One line, inlined into the triage lane table.

architect.description: agentType that drafts scope/spec and reviews this lane's phases.

dev.description: agentType that implements this lane's phases.

other_agents.description: Further routable agents belonging to the lane; reviewed by this lane's architect.

paths.description: Globs this lane owns; inlined into the triage lane table.

targeted_tests.description: One sentence: how to run a targeted selection (runner, shape, cwd, one example).

narrow_dirs.description: The only directories a phase may run whole, and only where its surface is that whole tier.

unlaned_agents.description: Routable agents that belong to no lane (e.g. a docs agent). Never a triage ## AS role; reviewed by the workstream's architect.

suites.description: Whole-suite runs executed by validate. Their commands are also the forbidden whole-suite invocations during implement. Suite names must be unique.

lane.description: Informational link to a lane name.

setup.description: Shell run before the command in the same shell (e.g. environment activation). Empty = none.

command.description: The exact full-suite command; must be correct with no flags added.

timeout_ms.description: Bash timeout. Above 600000 the validate agent runs the suite in the background with this timeout. 1800000 is the tool's hard cap.

notes.description: Runner caveats inlined verbatim into the validate prompt.

whole_suite_patterns.description: Extra phrasings of 'the whole suite' to forbid during implement, beyond suites[].command.

invariants.description: Names of load-bearing invariants, each a heading under steering.invariants_heading.

protected_guards.description: Guard test kinds the architect review's test-proportionality step never flags. The generic source-shape clause is always appended.

mandatory_tests.description: Tests a change still owes even under 'no test for a move or rename'.

when.description: The change that triggers the obligation (completes 'When ...').

requires.description: The test owed (completes 'the change still owes ...').

rule.description: Optional path of the path-scoped rule defining it.

models.description: Model tier per call kind. Values are names the Claude Code agent 'model' option accepts (e.g. fable, opus, sonnet, haiku).
